integrity_notes: A complete 24-face five-label local certificate and an all-order support reduction prove the elementary collapse. Numerical enumeration for ground-set orders five, six and seven is corroborative only. The intact sphere-wedge classification is attributed to previous work, not new.
scientific_limitations: Only single graph-edge deletion in two-subset Kneser graphs for n>=5, with higher-independence parameter two; not multiple faults, other Kneser parameters, or claimed equivariance of a chosen collapse.
title: Single-edge stability by elementary collapse in pair-Kneser dissociation complexes
